methods.name: GAN-MP
methods.summary: A two-stage unsupervised SITS analysis method. First, a GAN-based U-Net architecture performs inter-modality translation (SAR to optical). Second, a modified matrix profile algorithm is used on the translated SITS to identify anomalies, with an EM-based thresholding framework to delimit affected regions.
methods.verbatim: In this paper, we propose a new method, denoted as GAN-MP, for unsupervised SITS analysis in a multimodal setting.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code for the GAN-MP method lacks a repository or persistent link.
